chapter: Bands and musicians around New Orleans
title: Lincoln Park, the balloon and Robichaux
summary: Sunday dances at Lincoln Park with a balloon ascension, Robichaux playing the concert, Johnson Park and the baseball park.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: What about uptown?
Up where? Up in the garden?
Come on in. We're just talking.
Up in the garden, did you see?
Yeah. Did you ever go up around Betsy Coles? Oh, yeah.
I used to play every Sunday at Lincoln Park for Buddy Boulder. Oh, yeah? The balloon used to go up. Used to send the balloon up. We played on the inside at night for the dance.
Mm-hmm.
Robichaux played outside the concert.
Mm-hmm.
Yeah, what you see? Mm-hmm. The balloon used to have a big old balloon. Buddy Bottle. No, uh.
Bottle?
Buddy Bottle. He used to go up in it.
Did the balloon ever go loop to loop?
Yeah, man. I think... There was a horse wagon that used to run, you know. Mm-hmm. Follow it. It would come down.
Mm-hmm.
One time it got all tangled up in the wires up there.
Mm-hmm.
Yeah. All that smoke come out, you know. Mm-hmm. I used to call that the Lincoln Park.
Mm-hmm.
And across from Lincoln Park was Johnson Park. Mm-hmm. That was out there on Colton Avenue.
Oh, yeah. Of course you are. That's a filling station and a welfare office now.
It's a what?
A welfare office and a filling station out there now.
Yeah. Well, there used to be Lincoln Park. There was nothing but milk there. There was a lot of cows and goats out there.
Baseball?
Hmm?
Did you play baseball out there ever?
Well, uh.
At the bar?
At the all-in's, uh. Baseball Park at Colton Avenue and Tulane Avenue.
Well, I wasn't thinking about that. I was thinking up at Lincoln Park. I wonder if they would ever play baseball or have any kind of games there.
Not as I know. Yeah.
Did you play at Tulane and Colton?
No. At the ballpark? Yeah. No.
I know they had bands there one time.
Yeah, but no, I never.
Celestine and Happy Shilling, I think.
They do my time. And they had a band playing in there.
